title: A Cross-Platform Analysis of Practical Quantum Error Correction Codes
summary: The theory of quantum error correction was established decades ago. Yet limitations in physical noise levels and available physical-qubit counts continue to hinder the development of scalable quantum computing systems. In this paper, we present analytical estimates of logical error rates for advanced QEC codes across leading hardware platforms and distributed quantum computing systems using a simple but unified framework.
